what_to_detect: A power-up ability is a playable candidate (can_play true): its permanent entered this turn, so its cost is reduced, and it has not been activated before.
near_miss: A power-up ability is not playable (can_play false): its cost is not reduced (the permanent entered on an earlier turn), or it was already activated once (failed_checks activation_limit).
record_fields: decision candidate can_play, cost_after_adjustment, failed_checks activation_limit / cost (gen-3)
acting line script parameter PowerUp$ True
Power-up is the activated line's PowerUp$ True script parameter, not a keyword line; verdict_bit cannot restrict to it, and unrestricted any playable or affordable candidate fires.

what_to_detect: A power-up ability of a permanent that entered this turn is affordable (affordable true) once its cost is reduced by the permanent's mana cost, coloured symbols removing their own colour and the excess removing generic mana.
near_miss: A power-up ability is not affordable (affordable false) after the reduction, a coloured symbol of its cost left unreduced.
